name: Science
grading_rules: Grade the claim as stated. Documented = established science the evidence states plainly (or 'scientists found X' when the card reports that finding). Debated = active research question, contested or preliminary result, single study, or the evidence reports disagreement. Legend = popular science myth or misattributed story the evidence contradicts or presents as myth (e.g. 'we use only 10% of our brains', the Newton apple as a literal bonk). Interpretation = narrator's analogy or framing. Unsupported = no card says it. Never upgrade an analogy into a fact.
